evidence.ACC: ACC Limited (incorporated in 1936), a member of the Adani Group, is principally engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling of Cement and Ready Mix Concrete. The Company has manufacturing facilities across India and caters mainly to the domestic market. Parent Company Ambuja Cements, the parent company, is among India’s leading cement manufacturers and ranks as the 9th largest cement producer globally . The board approved the amalgamation of the company with Ambuja Cements in Dec 2025, and the merger scheme is expected to be completed in FY27
evidence.ACL: Incorporated in 1936, Andhra Cements Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and selling cement Corporate History & Ownership Changes Andhra Cements Limited has undergone multiple ownership transitions over the years from the Bennett Coleman Group to the Duncan Goenka Group in 1994, followed by the Jaypee Group in 2012. Following severe financial stress and plant shutdowns between 2020-2023, the company underwent CIRP . In Feb'23, the NCLT approved the resolution plan of Sagar Cements Ltd., which infused Rs. 322 Crs. and acquired control of the company. Andhra Cements is now a subsidiary of Sagar Cements and part of the Sagar Group.
evidence.AMBUJACEM: Ambuja Cements Ltd. is among the leading cement companies in India. It is a member of the Adani Group. Currently, Ambuja Cement has a cement capacity of 31 million tonnes with six integrated cement manufacturing plants and eight cement grinding units across the country. Promoter group Ambuja Cement is a part of the Adani group. The group owns Ambuja Cement, ACC and Sanghi Cements, Penna & Orient Cement in the cement sector. Adani group has businesses in various sectors like Energy & Utility, Transport & Logistics, Materials, Metal & Mining, Incubator and Specialty. Adani cement has 16.6% market share as of Q2 FY26.
evidence.APCL: Incorporated in 1983, Anjani Portland Cement Ltd manufactures high quality premium cement Business Overview: APCL is part of the Chettinad group and a subsidiary of Chettinad Cement Corporation Ltd(CCCL). Company is engaged in manufacturing and selling of cement, and power generation. Its business network is present in Tamil Nadu, Orissa and Karnataka and they have recently forayed into Maharashtra, Kerala and Goa
evidence.BIGBLOC: Incorporated in 2015, BigBloc Construction Ltd manufactures, sells and marketing of AAC Blocks Business Overview : BBCL is a manufacturer of AAC (Aerated Autoclave Concrete) block and related products manufacturing company in India
evidence.BIRLACORPN: Birla corporation It is a company of M.P Birla Group. The Co is engaged in the manufacturing of cement of various kinds and also has a presence in the jute goods industry. evidence.BURNPUR: Burnpur Cement Ltd is a formerly operating cement manufacturer that is now completely non-operational. All production assets have been sold, operating revenue has remained nil since FY25, and management and auditors assess the company as not a going concern . Current Operational status: The operations were discontinued from November 2023, and the company had no manufacturing unit as of June 2026. Revenue remained nil in FY26 and Q1FY27. Historically, BCL manufactured Portland Slag Cement, OPC and PPC products for housing and infrastructure. Under its last operating model, the entire output was sold to UltraTech; there are no current products or customers following the asset sale.
